releaseNotes:
• Real Vector Icons: Replaced emoji characters on keys & toolbar with sleek native vector drawables (backspace, shift, enter, globe, mic, clipboard, sparkles)
• Unified Emoji & Symbols Hub: Integrated 15,000+ Unicode symbols, Kaomojis and Emojis into one panel with top tab switcher
• Smooth Panel Scrolling: Resolved scroll interception; buttery smooth vertical and horizontal scrolling
• Dynamic Liquid Sloshing & Snow Tilt: Realistic phone tilt angle water sloshing, splash ripples, lightning flash, and frosted translucent keys
